    (IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project) || IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project.Status)),
    Color.Transparent,
    If(
        Or(
            cmp_Header.Project.Status = "Abandoned",
            "Inactive" in cmp_Header.Project.Status
        ),
        gblAppColors.Error,
        gblAppColors.ApprovalClusterStates.InProgress

    Or(
        gblEnvironmentName = "QA",

        "Inactive" in cmp_Header.Project.Status,

        Icon.Information
    )
)

            cmp_Header.Project.Status = "Abandoned",

        ),
        cmp_Header.Project.Status,
        "Active"

    false,

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'SPV Legal Structure')),
    LookUp(
        Choices('SPV Legal Structure (Projects)'),
        Value = gblRecordSelectedProject.'SPV Legal Structure'
    )
)
"Please select the legal structure of SPV"

If(
    Not(Self.Text = Text(gblRecordSelectedProject.'SPV Company Code')),
    UpdateContext({locIsGeneralFormDirty: true})
)

If(
    IsBlank(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_SPVCompanyCode.Text),
    "SPV Company Code cannot be blank.",
    Not(
        fn_Numeric_GD.InRange(
            (txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_SPVCompanyCode.Text),
            1000,
            9999
        )
    ),
    "SPV Company Code is expected in #### format with Numeric values."
)

If(
    Len(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_SPVName.Text) <> 0 && Len(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_SPVCompanyCode.Text) <> 0,
    If(
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_GD.InRange(
                (txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_SPVCompanyCode.Text),
                1000,
                9999
            )
        ),
        true,
        false
    ),
    Len(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_SPVName.Text) <> 0 && Len(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_SPVCompanyCode.Text) = 0,
    true,
    Len(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_SPVName.Text) = 0 && Len(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_SPVCompanyCode.Text) <> 0,
    If(
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_GD.InRange(
                (txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_SPVCompanyCode.Text),
                1000,
                9999
            )
        ),
        true,
        false
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Or(
        drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_ProjectDevelopment.Selected.Value <> 'Development Type'.'Acquired Project',
        Coalesce(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Order, 0) > 0
    ),
    DisplayMode.Disabled,
    DisplayMode.Edit
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_ProjectDevelopment.Selected.Value = 'Development Type'.'Own Development',
    LookUp(
        Choices('Cluster States'),
        Value = 'Cluster States'.Greenfield
    ),
    Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Start Cluster')),
    LookUp(
        Choices('Cluster States'),
        Value = gblRecordSelectedProject.'Start Cluster'
    )
)

If(
    Not(Self.Selected.Value = gblRecordSelectedProject.'Start Cluster'),
    UpdateContext({locIsGeneralFormDirty: true})
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Or(
        drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_ProjectDevelopment.Selected.Value <> 'Development Type'.'Acquired Project',
        And(
            Coalesce(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Order,
                0
            ) >= Switch(
                drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ClusterChange.Selected.Value,
                'Cluster States'.Greenfield,
                0,
                'Cluster States'.'Cluster 1',
                1,
                'Cluster States'.'Cluster 2',
                2,
                'Cluster States'.'Cluster 3',
                3,
                'Cluster States'.'Cluster 4',
                4,
                'Cluster States'.'Cluster 5',
                5,
                'Cluster States'.'Cluster 6',
                6,
                0
            ),
            Not(IsBlank(drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ClusterChange.Selected.Value))
        )
    ),
    DisplayMode.Disabled,
    DisplayMode.Edit
)

If(
    Not(Self.SelectedDate = gblRecordSelectedProject.'Acquisition date'),
    UpdateContext({locIsGeneralFormDirty: true})
)

If(
    IsBlank(Trim(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_AcquisitionPrice.Text)),
    "Acquisition Price should not be blank.",
    $"The cost needs to be a whole number, without any decimal places, in the range of 0 to {Text(
        1000000000,
        "#,###,###,###",
        Language()
    )}."
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
Sort(
    Filter(
        colCustomChoiceValues,
        And(
            vsb_fieldname = "vsb_terrainutilization",
            Or(
                IsBlank(vsb_Country.Country),
                Or(
                    IsBlank(drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected),
                    vsb_Country.Country = drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Country
                )
            )
        )
    ),
    vsb_order,
    SortOrder.Ascending
)

If(
    Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.Utilization)),
    LookUp(
        colCustomChoiceValues,
        vsb_customchoicevalueid = gblRecordSelectedProject.Utilization.'Custom Choice Value'
    )
)

If(
    IsBlank(Trim(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_TerrainSize.Text)),
    gblAppResx.InputBlank,
    Not(fn_Numeric_GD.IsOneDecimal(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_TerrainSize.Text)),
    gblAppResx.NumericOneDecimals,
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_TerrainSize.Text)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_GD.InRange(
                txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_TerrainSize.Text,
                0.1,
                1000
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        1000,
        "###,###"
    )}"
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    And(
        If(
            IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject),
            DataSourceInfo(
                Projects,
                DataSourceInfo.CreatePermission
            ),
            RecordInfo(
                gblRecordSelectedProject,
                RecordInfo.EditPermission
            )
        ),
        locIsGeneralFormDirty,
        Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ProjectName.Text))),
        Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ShortName.Text))),
        Not(IsBlank(drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_Technology.Selected)),
        Not(IsBlank(First(pcf_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Manager_PeoplePicker.SelectedPeople))),
        If(
            CountRows(
                Filter(
                    CountryAreas,
                    Or(
                        Country.Country = gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Country,
                        Country.Country = drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Country
                    )
                )
            ) > 0,
            Not(IsBlank(drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Area.Selected)),
            true
        ),
        If(
            Or(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Key = "25",
                drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Key = "25"
            ),
            Not(IsBlank(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_TerrainSize.Text)),
            true
        ),
        Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Latitude.Text))),
        Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Longitude.Text))),
        Or(
            CountIf(
                colShareholdingEntities,
                true
            ) > 0,
            CountRows(
                Filter(
                    ShareholderEntityInProjects,
                    ThisRecord.Project.Project = gblRecordSelectedProject.Project
                )
            ) > 0
        ),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ProjectName_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ShortName_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_Technology_ErrMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Manager_ErrMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_ProjectDevelopment_ErrMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ClusterChange_ErrorMessage.Visible && conGeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_PGroup_5Row_2.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_AcquisitionDate_ErrorMessage.Visible && conGeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_PGroup_5Row_2.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_AcquisitionDate_ErrorMessage_1.Visible && conGeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_PGroup_5Row_2.Visible),
        If(
            CountRows(
                Filter(
                    CountryAreas,
                    Or(
                        Country.Country = gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Country,
                        Country.Country = drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Country
                    )
                )
            ) > 0,
            Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Area_ErrorMessage.Visible),
            true
        ),
        If(
            Or(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Key = "25",
                drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Key = "25"
            ),
            Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_TerrainSize_ErrorMessage.Visible),
            true
        ),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Latitude_ErrMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Longitude_ErrMessage.Visible),
        Sum(
            colShareholdingEntities,
            'Ownership [%]'
        ) = 1,
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_SPVCompanyCode_ErrMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_SPVLegalStructure_ErrMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Tax_Factor_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(
            And(
                drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Name = "Germany",
                IsBlank(cmb_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Municipality_Germany.Selected.municipality)
            )
        ),
        Not(
            And(
                drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Name = "France",
                IsBlank(cmb_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Municipality_France_1.Selected.Municipality)
            )
        )
    ),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

With(
    {
        varSelectedDevelopmentType: drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_ProjectDevelopment.Selected.Value,
        varSelectedStartCluster: drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ClusterChange.Selected.Value
    },
    With(
        {
            varPreviousCluster: Coalesce(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Start Cluster',
                'Cluster States'.Greenfield
            ),
            varNewCluster: If(
                varSelectedDevelopmentType = 'Development Type'.'Acquired Project',
                Coalesce(
                    varSelectedStartCluster,
                    'Cluster States'.Greenfield
                ),
                'Cluster States'.Greenfield
            ),
            varHasAnyMilestoneData: Or(
                Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Project Start Date')),
                Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'1-Feasibility studies')),
                Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'2-Project development started')),
                Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'3-Application submitted')),
                Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'4-Legally binding permits')),
                Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Final Investment Decision')),
                Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'5-Construction')),
                Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)'))
            )
        },
        With(
            {
                varPreviousNo: Switch(
                    varPreviousCluster,
                    'Cluster States'.Greenfield,
                    0,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 1',
                    1,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 2',
                    2,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 3',
                    3,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 4',
                    4,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 5',
                    5,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 6',
                    6,
                    0
                ),
                varNewNo: Switch(
                    varNewCluster,
                    'Cluster States'.Greenfield,
                    0,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 1',
                    1,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 2',
                    2,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 3',
                    3,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 4',
                    4,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 5',
                    5,
                    'Cluster States'.'Cluster 6',
                    6,
                    0
                )
            },
            With(
                {
                    // Cluster 5 and Cluster 6 have same milestone impact.
                    // Both keep FID and Cluster 5 mandatory.
varPreviousMilestoneImpactNo: If(
                        varPreviousNo >= 5,
                        5,
                        varPreviousNo
                    ),
                    varNewMilestoneImpactNo: If(
                        varNewNo >= 5,
                        5,
                        varNewNo
                    ),
                    // Upward popup should open only if there is actually
                    // a milestone date that will be deleted.
varHasAnyMilestoneToDelete: Or(
                        varNewNo >= 1 && Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Project Start Date')),
                        varNewNo >= 2 && Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'1-Feasibility studies')),
                        varNewNo >= 3 && Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'2-Project development started')),
                        varNewNo >= 4 && Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'3-Application submitted')),
                        varNewNo >= 5 && Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'4-Legally binding permits'))
                    )
                },
                If(
                    // Own Development always saves directly as Greenfield
                    varSelectedDevelopmentType = 'Development Type'.'Own Development',
                    Select(btn_GeneralData_Save_Actual),
                    // Acquired + Greenfield saves directly
                    varNewNo = 0,
                    Select(btn_GeneralData_Save_Actual),
                    // Exact same Start Cluster saves directly
                    varPreviousNo = varNewNo,
                    Select(btn_GeneralData_Save_Actual),
                    // Cluster 5 <-> Cluster 6 should save directly.
// Because no milestone is deleted and no milestone input is needed.
                    varPreviousMilestoneImpactNo = varNewMilestoneImpactNo,
                    Select(btn_GeneralData_Save_Actual),
                    // If there is no milestone data at all, save directly.
// User can change Start Cluster multiple times before milestone data exists.
                    Not(varHasAnyMilestoneData),
                    Select(btn_GeneralData_Save_Actual),
                    // Upward movement:
// If all milestones that would be deleted are already blank,
// do not show empty popup. Save directly.
                    And(
                        varNewMilestoneImpactNo > varPreviousMilestoneImpactNo,
                        Not(varHasAnyMilestoneToDelete)
                    ),
                    Select(btn_GeneralData_Save_Actual),
                    // Popup opens only when Start Cluster change has real milestone impact
                    ClearCollect(
                        colClusterStatesDataTable,
                        'Project States'
                    );
                    UpdateContext(
                        {
                            locClusterChangePreviousStartClusterName: varPreviousCluster,
                            locClusterChangeNewStartClusterName: varNewCluster,
                            locPreviousStartClusterNo: varPreviousNo,
                            locNewStartClusterNo: varNewNo,
                            locSelectedStartCluster: varNewNo,
                            locSelectedStartClusterNo: varNewNo,
                            locClusterChangeIsUpward: varNewMilestoneImpactNo > varPreviousMilestoneImpactNo,
                            locClusterChangeIsDownward: varNewMilestoneImpactNo < varPreviousMilestoneImpactNo,
                            locClusterChangeRequiresMilestoneInput: varNewMilestoneImpactNo < varPreviousMilestoneImpactNo,
                            locClusterChangeProjectStartDate: gblRecordSelectedProject.'Project Start Date',
                            locClusterChangeCluster1Date: gblRecordSelectedProject.'1-Feasibility studies',
                            locClusterChangeCluster2Date: gblRecordSelectedProject.'2-Project development started',
                            locClusterChangeCluster3Date: gblRecordSelectedProject.'3-Application submitted',

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    And(
        If(
            IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject),
            DataSourceInfo(
                Projects,
                DataSourceInfo.CreatePermission
            ),
            RecordInfo(
                gblRecordSelectedProject,
                RecordInfo.EditPermission
            )
        ),
        locIsGeneralFormDirty,
        Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ProjectName.Text))),
        Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ShortName.Text))),
        Not(IsBlank(drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_Technology.Selected)),
        Not(IsBlank(First(pcf_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Manager_PeoplePicker.SelectedPeople))),
        If(
            CountRows(
                Filter(
                    CountryAreas,
                    Or(
                        Country.Country = gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Country,
                        Country.Country = drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Country
                    )
                )
            ) > 0,
            Not(IsBlank(drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Area.Selected)),
            true
        ),
        If(
            Or(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Key = "25",
                drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Key = "25"
            ),
            Not(IsBlank(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_TerrainSize.Text)),
            true
        ),
        Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Latitude.Text))),
        Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Longitude.Text))),
        Or(
            CountIf(
                colShareholdingEntities,
                true
            ) > 0,
            CountRows(
                Filter(
                    ShareholderEntityInProjects,
                    ThisRecord.Project.Project = gblRecordSelectedProject.Project
                )
            ) > 0
        ),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ProjectName_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ShortName_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_Technology_ErrMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Manager_ErrMessage.Visible),
        //Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_ProjectDevelopment_ErrMessage.Visible),
        //Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ClusterChange_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        If(
            CountRows(
                Filter(
                    CountryAreas,
                    Or(
                        Country.Country = gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Country,
                        Country.Country = drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Country
                    )
                )
            ) > 0,
            Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Area_ErrorMessage.Visible),
            true
        ),
        If(
            Or(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Key = "25",
                drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Key = "25"
            ),
            Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_TerrainSize_ErrorMessage.Visible),
            true
        ),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Latitude_ErrMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Longitude_ErrMessage.Visible),
        Sum(colShareholdingEntities,'Ownership [%]')=1,
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_SPVCompanyCode_ErrMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_SPVLegalStructure_ErrMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Tax_Factor_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(
            And(
                drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Name = "Germany",
                IsBlank(cmb_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Municipality_Germany.Selected.municipality)
            )
        ),
        Not(
            And(
                drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Name = "France",
                IsBlank(cmb_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Municipality_France_1.Selected.Municipality)
            )
        )
    ),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

Or(
    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ProjectName_ErrorMessage.Visible,
    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ShortName_ErrorMessage.Visible,
    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_Technology_ErrMessage.Visible,
    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Manager_ErrMessage.Visible,
    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country_ErrorMessage.Visible,
    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_SPVCompanyCode_ErrMessage.Visible,
    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_SPVLegalStructure_ErrMessage.Visible,
    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_TechnologyTab_Content_ProjectDevelopment_ErrMessage.Visible,

    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_ClusterChange_ErrorMessage.Visible && conGeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_PGroup_5Row_2.Visible ,
    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_AcquisitionDate_ErrorMessage.Visible && conGeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_PGroup_5Row_2.Visible,
    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_AcquisitionDate_ErrorMessage_1.Visible && conGeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_PGroup_5Row_2.Visible,
    If(
        CountRows(
            Filter(
                CountryAreas,
                Or(
                    Country.Country = gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Country,
                    Country.Country = drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Country
                )
            )
        ) > 0,
        lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Area_ErrorMessage.Visible,
        false
    ),
    If(
        Or(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Key = "25",
            drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Key = "25"
        ),
        lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_TerrainSize_ErrorMessage.Visible,
        false
    ),
    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Latitude_ErrMessage.Visible,
    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Longitude_ErrMessage.Visible,
    Sum(
        colShareholdingEntities,
        'Ownership [%]'
    ) <> 1,
    lbl_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Tax_Factor_ErrorMessage.Visible,
    And(
        drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Name = "Germany",
        IsBlank(cmb_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Municipality_Germany.Selected.municipality)
    ),
    And(
        drp_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Country.Selected.Name = "France",
        IsBlank(cmb_GeneralData_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Municipality_France_1.Selected.Municipality)
    )
)

    locClusterChangeIsUpward,
    DisplayMode.Disabled,
    locClusterChangeIsDownward && locNewStartClusterNo <= 1 && locPreviousStartClusterNo > 1,
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

If(
    locClusterChangeIsUpward,
    DisplayMode.View,
    locClusterChangeIsDownward && locNewStartClusterNo <= 1 && locPreviousStartClusterNo > 1,
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.View
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1_1.SelectedDate),
    "Cluster 1 date cannot be blank.",

    And(
        locNewStartClusterNo = 0,
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_StartDate_1.SelectedDate)),
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1_1.SelectedDate <=
            dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_StartDate_1.SelectedDate
    ),
    "Cluster 1 must be later than Project Start."
)

locClusterChangeIsDownward &&
con_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1_1.Visible &&
Or(
    And(
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1_1.DisplayMode = DisplayMode.Edit,
        IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1_1.SelectedDate)
    ),

    And(
        locNewStartClusterNo = 0,
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_StartDate_1.SelectedDate)),
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1_1.SelectedDate)),
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1_1.SelectedDate <=
            dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_StartDate_1.SelectedDate
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Or(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology = gblAppConstants.Texnology.Wind,
        gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology = gblAppConstants.Texnology.PV
    ),
    32,
    0
)

And(locClusterChangeIsDownward ,
dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2_1.DisplayMode = DisplayMode.Edit ,
Or(
    gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology = gblAppConstants.Texnology.Wind,
    gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology = gblAppConstants.Texnology.PV
))

If(
    IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2_1.SelectedDate),
    "Cluster 2 date cannot be blank.",

    And(
        locNewStartClusterNo <= 1,
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1_1.SelectedDate)),
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2_1.SelectedDate <=
            dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1_1.SelectedDate
    ),
    "Cluster 2 must be later than Cluster 1."
)

locClusterChangeIsDownward &&
con_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2_1.Visible &&
Or(
    And(
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2_1.DisplayMode = DisplayMode.Edit,
        IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2_1.SelectedDate)
    ),

    And(
        locNewStartClusterNo <= 1,
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1_1.SelectedDate)),
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2_1.SelectedDate)),
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2_1.SelectedDate <=
            dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1_1.SelectedDate
    )
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString: "The date needs to be later than Cluster 1 date."

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Or(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology = gblAppConstants.Texnology.Wind,
        gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology = gblAppConstants.Texnology.PV
    ),
    32,
    0
)

And(
    locClusterChangeIsDownward,
    dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3_1.DisplayMode = DisplayMode.Edit,
    Or(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology = gblAppConstants.Texnology.Wind,
        gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology = gblAppConstants.Texnology.PV
    )
)

And(locClusterChangeIsDownward ,
dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2_1.DisplayMode = DisplayMode.Edit ,
Or(
    gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology = gblAppConstants.Texnology.Wind,
    gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology = gblAppConstants.Texnology.PV
))

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3_1.SelectedDate),
    "Cluster 3 date cannot be blank.",

    And(
        locNewStartClusterNo <= 2,
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2_1.SelectedDate)),
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3_1.SelectedDate <=
            dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2_1.SelectedDate
    ),
    "Cluster 3 must be later than Cluster 2."
)

locClusterChangeIsDownward &&
con_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3_1.Visible &&
Or(
    And(
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3_1.DisplayMode = DisplayMode.Edit,
        IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3_1.SelectedDate)
    ),

    And(
        locNewStartClusterNo <= 2,
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2_1.SelectedDate)),
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3_1.SelectedDate)),
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3_1.SelectedDate <=
            dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2_1.SelectedDate
    )
)

If(
    IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster4_1.SelectedDate),
    "Cluster 4 date cannot be blank.",

    And(
        locNewStartClusterNo <= 3,
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3_1.SelectedDate)),
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster4_1.SelectedDate <=
            dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3_1.SelectedDate
    ),
    "Cluster 4 must be later than Cluster 3."
)

locClusterChangeIsDownward &&
con_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster4_1.Visible &&
Or(
    And(
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster4_1.DisplayMode = DisplayMode.Edit,
        IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster4_1.SelectedDate)
    ),

    And(
        locNewStartClusterNo <= 3,
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3_1.SelectedDate)),
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster4_1.SelectedDate)),
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster4_1.SelectedDate <=
            dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3_1.SelectedDate
    )
)

    IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_FiD_1.SelectedDate),

    And(
        locNewStartClusterNo <= 4,
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster4_1.SelectedDate)),
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_FiD_1.SelectedDate <=

    And(
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_FiD_1.DisplayMode = DisplayMode.Edit,
        IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_FiD_1.SelectedDate)
    ),

    And(
        locNewStartClusterNo <= 4,
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster4_1.SelectedDate)),
        Not(IsBlank(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_FiD_1.SelectedDate)),
        dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_FiD_1.SelectedDate <=
            dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster4_1.SelectedDate
    )

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
With(
    {
        varAutoSkippedComment: "Automatically completed because this project starts at a later cluster."
    },
    If(
        locProjectStartClusterNo > 0,
        With(
            {
                varStatesWithClusterNo: AddColumns(
                    Filter(
                        'Project States' As PS,
                        PS.'Is Visible On Checklist' = true &&
                        PS.Name in [
                            "Draft",
                            "Cluster 1",
                            "Cluster 2",
                            "Cluster 3",
                            "Cluster 4",
                            "Cluster 5",
                            "Cluster 6"
                        ]
                    ) As PS,
                    ClusterNo,
                    Switch(
                        PS.Name,
                        "Draft", 0,
                        "Cluster 1", 1,
                        "Cluster 2", 2,
                        "Cluster 3", 3,
                        "Cluster 4", 4,
                        "Cluster 5", 5,
                        "Cluster 6", 6,
                        999
                    )
                )
            },
            ForAll(
                varStatesWithClusterNo As StateRow,
                With(
                    {
                        varExistingTracking: LookUp(
                            'Project State Trackings',
                            Project.Project = gblRecordSelectedProject.Project &&
                            'Cluster State'.'Project State' = StateRow.'Project State'
                        ),
                        varTargetApprovalState: If(
                            StateRow.ClusterNo > 0 &&
                            StateRow.ClusterNo < locProjectStartClusterNo,
                            'Approval Cluster States'.Completed,
                            'Approval Cluster States'.'Not Started'
                        ),
                        varTargetComment: If(
                            StateRow.ClusterNo > 0 &&
                            StateRow.ClusterNo < locProjectStartClusterNo,
                            varAutoSkippedComment,
                            Blank()
                        )
                    },
                    Patch(
                        'Project State Trackings',
                        Coalesce(
                            varExistingTracking,
                            Defaults('Project State Trackings')
                        ),
                        {
                            Project: gblRecordSelectedProject,
                            'Cluster State': LookUp(
                                'Project States',
                                'Project State' = StateRow.'Project State'
                            ),
                            'Approval Cluster State': varTargetApprovalState,
                            'Cluster Step State': Blank(),
                            'Approval Due Date': Blank(),
                            FlowRunId: Blank(),
                            FlowApprovalId: Blank(),
                            'Approval Comment': varTargetComment,
                            'Owning Business Unit': gblRecordSelectedProject.'Besitzer (Unternehmenseinheit)'
                        }
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
)
